sites.source: MN DNR facility cmp00009 (camping: drive_in_campsites 25, group_campsites 1, accessible_campsites 1), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: MN DNR facility cmp00009 ('The campsites are considered "primitive," designed to furnish only the basic needs of the camper. The campsites consist of a cleared area, fire ring, and table'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: MN DNR facility cmp00009 ('Vault toilets, garbage cans, and drinking water are available'; toilets 3, wells 2), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Individual sites are first come; the fee is paid online on the day of arrival (or at a state park ranger station) before taking a site. The group site ($50) is reserved through ReserveMN up to 120 days ahead.

booking.source: MN DNR facility cmp00009 ('All campsites require a fee that must be paid before occupying a campsite. Same-day advance payments are available for individual and equestrian campsites'; 'Reservations for group campsites can be made up to 120 days in advance') + https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/fees-reservations.html ('Group campsites $50'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Minnesota state forest individual campsite, taxes included ($22 applies only to equestrian sites, none here). Paid online on the arrival date or at a state park ranger station; nothing is collected at the campground. DNR state forest fee page, read 2026-11-11.

fees.source: https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/fees-reservations.html ('Individual and equestrian campsites $17 - $22'; 'Starting in 2026 ... $17 per night ($22 for equestrian)'; 'Fees include taxes'; 'DNR does not accept self-payment envelopes on site') + DNR facility cmp00009 (no equestrian sites), read 2026-11-11

note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground beside the Indian Lake public landing in Cloquet Valley State Forest, with a sandy swimming beach, boat ramp and dock. A starting point for the Cloquet River State Water Trail. Managed from the DNR Parks and Trails area office in Two Harbors. --Claude
summary: DNR facility cmp00009 read: 25 primitive drive-in sites + 1 group site, vault toilets, wells, beach, boat ramp; $17 tax-included same-day pay (high 22 -> 17: equestrian rate not here); group site reservable. Not waterfront kept. Phone missing -> 218-834-1430; website hyphen.
flags: FEES nightly_high 22 -> 17: the $22 figure is the statewide equestrian rate; Indian Lake has no equestrian sites.
